programme.desc: S06 E20 — La rage au ventreCallen et Sam reprennent leurs identités secrètes en tant que prisonnier pour l'un et garde pour l'autre afin d'infiltrer un groupe de suprématie blanche suspecté d'être en possession de matériel nucléaire volé.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: S23 E05 — Hier et aujourd'huiL'évasion d'un détenu n'ayant plus que trois semaines de peine à purger pousse l'équipe à ouvrir de nouveau l'enquête sur le décès d'un officier de la Marine, un dossier sur lequel ont travaillé les agents Gibbs et Franks au cours des années 1990.

programme.title: NCIS: Sydney
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Nés sous le signe des GémeauxInquiet pour Blue, Doc s'introduit par effraction dans son appartement; sur les lieux, DeShawn et Evie font une découverte troublante concernant un de leurs collègues.

programme.title: NCIS: origines
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Un seul être vous manqueGibbs et Frank enquêtent sur la disparition d'un jeune membre de la marine américaine; sa disparition serait liée à un mystérieux groupe dirigé par un chef charismatique; pendant ce temps, le sort de Lala est révélé.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: S02 E11 — RépercussionsAprès la mort d'un homme d'affaires ayant fait l'objet de plusieurs plaintes pour harcèlement, l'équipe soupçonne que le coupable pourrait être l'un de ses nombreux accusateurs.

programme.title: Hawaii sauvetage extrême
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Sortie de routeWill, Laka et Em reçoivent un appel pour sauver une influenceuse en robe de mariée emportée par l'océan alors qu'elle filmait une nouvelle vidéo ; Kainalu et Hina discutent de la mise en place de limites dans leur vie commune.

programme.title: Found: les oubliés
programme.desc: S02 E19 — Disparition: un homme déclaré mortJamie apporte une nouvelle affaire à l'agence; Allison veut retrouver son père pour sauver la vie de son frère avec une greffe de rein; leur père a été déclaré mort après l'effondrement de deux tours, mais elle est persuadée qu'il est encore en vie.

programme.title: Sheriff Country: shérif sur appel
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Entretien de départUn cadavre est découvert en bordure de la rivière; Mickey et son équipe mènent une enquête qui bouleverse grandement tous les habitants de la ville; pendant ce temps, Wes est prêt à tout afin de découvrir la vérité sur ce meurtre.

programme.title: Esprits brillants
programme.desc: S01 E02 — La femme désincarnéeLorsqu'une entraîneuse de basketball de lycée est confrontée à une maladie débilitante, Dr Wolf doit aider sa patiente à se reconnecter à son corps avant qu'il ne soit trop tard ; Ericka et Dana traitent un étudiant qui voit des dragons.

programme.title: La loi et l'ordre: crimes sexuels
programme.desc: S25 E07 — Un père indigneLorsqu'une femme dénonce son mari pour possession de matériel pédopornographique, l'affaire se complique par une mort soudaine ; Benson tente de renouer avec une victime qu'elle a sauvée.

programme.title: Élémentaire
programme.desc: S05 E21 — Colère noireQuand la petite amie de Bell est agressée et que l'ex-mari de celle-ci est tué peu de temps après, Holmes et Watson cherchent le tueur lié aux deux crimes.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Les huit d'EllardLorsque l'enseignant le plus aimé d'une prestigieuse école privée est accusé d'entretenir une relation inappropriée avec une étudiante, Shade et Angie sont engagés pour enquêter sur le scandale.

programme.title: Dernière escale
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Les règles du jeuKendra fait de plus en plus confiance à Ellen Hunter, l'agente du FBI avec laquelle elle collabore à la suite du déraillement du train; le sentiment semble réciproque, puisque les deux enquêteuses n'hésitent pas à se partager des informations.

programme.title: Aide-moi Todd
programme.desc: S02 E06 — Diffamation et enquête secrèteLawrence fait appel aux services de Todd pour découvrir l'orientation sexuelle d'un juge ; par ailleurs, alors que le gagne-pain de son client est en jeu, Margaret demande l'aide de Lyle pour chercher un témoin plus que réticent.

programme.title: La famille fait loi
programme.desc: S04 E05 — Mission parentAbby et Daniel représentent Diana, une mère poursuivie par un couple après que sa fille adolescente a volé leur voiture et l'a accidentée ; Harry aide un client à contester un testament dans lequel sa tante décédée a légué sa fortune à son chat.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: S11 E17 — Le come-backUne bombe explose dans une loge pendant qu'un groupe de musique répète en vue d'un concert-bénéfice. Le NCIS doit déterminer si la cible était simplement un vieux rockeur ou si la bombe visait un plus grand groupe de personnes.

programme.title: Nuit blanche
programme.desc: S02 E01 — La morteEn 1980: célèbre mannequin, Louise renoue avec son ancienne voisine Jacinthe; le Québec est en pleine campagne pour l'indépendance de la province, mais le référendum se solde par un échec; Louise et Jacinthe se permettent de rêver grand.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: S11 E14 — Le langage de l'amourGarrett Moore, le commissaire adjoint aux communications, refuse de rectifier une citation qu'il a fournie à un journal local; Frank est dans tous ses états.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: S16 E01 — Les filles aux miraclesAmy accomplit un autre miracle auprès d'un cheval dans le besoin ; elle en vient à reconsidérer son rôle au centre jeunesse ; Jack s'ennuie de Lisa et la présence constante de Tim et de Jessica à la maison est loin d'aider la situation.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: S14 E06 — Les poupées russesL'équipe enquête sur l'enlèvement d'une quartier-maître de la Navy et sur la disparition de son mari ; Torres tente de s'excuser auprès d'Abby.

programme.title: La famille fait loi
programme.desc: S04 E05 — Mission parentAbby et Daniel représentent Diana, une mère poursuivie par un couple après que sa fille adolescente a volé leur voiture et l'a accidentée ; Harry aide un client à contester un testament dans lequel sa tante décédée a légué sa fortune à son chat.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: S03 E09 — Destins croisésUne force terrible gâche le jour du mariage de Cat et Vincent ; tout le monde s'unit pour rappeler à Cat son plus grand but.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: S07 E02 — Trésor cachéL'équipe enquête sur le meurtre d'un couple de banlieue, alors que toutes les preuves médico-légales pointent vers l'ancien propriétaire de la maison, qui purge actuellement une peine de 10 ans de prison ; OA retrouve un ancien collègue de l'armée.

programme.title: Sheriff Country: shérif sur appel
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Entretien de départUn cadavre est découvert en bordure de la rivière; Mickey et son équipe mènent une enquête qui bouleverse grandement tous les habitants de la ville; pendant ce temps, Wes est prêt à tout afin de découvrir la vérité sur ce meurtre.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: S06 E21 — Les malheurs d'ArkadyArkady Kolcheck, ancien membre du KGB et vieille connaissance du NCIS, échappe de peu à une tentative de meurtre.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S02 E09 — À nouveau ennemis dès lundiLes Dutton se préparent pour un dernier combat avec les Beck; Beth aide Monica à sortir d'une situation inconfortable.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S02 E10 — Les pêchés du pèreLa querelle avec les Beck s'achève lorsque les Dutton se débattent pour sauver un membre de leur équipe.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: S03 E01 — C'est vous l'Indien, maintenantDans le sillage des frères Beck, John remanie les plateaux politiques ; Beth trouve un intrus sur le ranch.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: S02 E12 — DeepfakeUn vol de banque conduit l'équipe à un coffre-fort dont le contenu est susceptible de nuire à la sécurité nationale; Kristen est impatiente de reprendre le travail sur le terrain, alors que d'autres membres de l'équipe sont réticents à cette idée.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: S08 E02 — L'art du crimeDes tableaux d'un important événement culturel international sont dérobés et un agent de sécurité est tué; l'équipe se lance dans une course contre-la-montre pour tenter de récupérer ces oeuvres inestimables.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: S04 E13 — La Mafia d'outre-tombeJay s'attire les foudres d'un restaurateur local en utilisant pour son restaurant une recette de sauce arrabbiata léguée par Pete; Hetty convainc Flower d'emménager dans la chambre de Thor et Trevor; Trevor menace de s'installer dans celle de Hetty.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: S04 E14 — Alexander Hamilton et le vol du JabotJay devient complètement obsédé par le succès qu'obtient un autre chef de restaurant; Isaac lui raconte alors sa propre histoire de rivalité avec Alexander Hamilton; Elias Woodstone revient de l'enfer avec une proposition pour les fantômes.

programme.title: Boston Blue
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Bagage oubliéDanny et Lena voient leurs rôles s'inverser de manière inattendue; Sarah est confrontée à un dilemme personnel qui ébranle sa confiance; Mae ressent beaucoup de pression entourant un dossier politique; Sean et Jonah font une découverte surprenante.

programme.title: The Gold: le casse du siècle
programme.desc: S01 E06 — On se souviendra de moiOn rencontre un Anglais à l'allure formidable, Charlie Miller, dans une luxueuse villa de la Méditerranée; de retour en Angleterre, Brian Boyce, chef de l'équipe spéciale chargée d'enquêter sur le vol de Brink's-Mat, interroge John Palmer.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Le prix de la trahisonL'équipe entre en action après que quatre détectives ont été abattus lors d'un échange de prisonniers à l'extérieur d'un restaurant dans le New Jersey ; pendant ce temps, Remy a du mal à accepter que Corey soit son colocataire.

programme.title: Élémentaire
programme.desc: S05 E22 — Le fantôme de GuluQuand un concurrent d'une téléréalité est assassiné, Sherlock et Watson suspectent un autre participant ; Shinwell se tourne vers Watson pour lui demander une faveur, la première depuis qu'il a attaqué Sherlock.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: S02 E04 — Un crime sur mesureLa créatrice de mode Carla Costa engage Shade et Angie pour surveiller sa nouvelle collection, mais celle-ci est volée quelques jours seulement avant le défilé de sa carrière.

programme.title: Hawaii sauvetage extrême
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Sortie de routeWill, Laka et Em reçoivent un appel pour sauver une influenceuse en robe de mariée emportée par l'océan alors qu'elle filmait une nouvelle vidéo ; Kainalu et Hina discutent de la mise en place de limites dans leur vie commune.

programme.title: Aide-moi Todd
programme.desc: S02 E07 — Un mort parmi les vivantsMargaret et Todd font équipe pour aider un homme qui a été déclaré légalement mort, alors qu'il est bien vivant.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: S03 E07 — Mariage expressCat et Vincent tentent d'attirer un assassin hors de la ville pour protéger leurs proches ; Heather essaie de se concentrer sur son nouvel emploi.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: S11 E18 — Le privilégiéGibbs retrouve un ancien collègue pour résoudre une enquête sur le meurtre de Dan McLane, un membre du congrès, dont le corps a été retrouvé sur la côte de La Nouvelle-Orléans.

programme.title: Found: les oubliés
programme.desc: S02 E20 — Disparition: une femme indépendanteL'équipe est sur tous les fronts; Jamie essaie de tendre un piège à Carrie; Gabi apprend que Lena s'en est prise à Jinny; un jeune homme distribue des affiches: sa fiancée a disparu, et Margaret lui propose de l'aider à la retrouver.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: S11 E15 — Sous couvertureDanny découvre que le nouveau membre de la grande famille Reagan, Joe Hill, est en mission d'infiltration pour le Bureau de l'alcool, du tabac, des armes à feu et des explosifs.

programme.title: Moonshine
programme.desc: S02 E08 — Comment trainer un Finley-Cullen dans la boueGale et son gang de motards imposent leur présence au Moonshine; se voyant ainsi engagés dans une guerre de territoire, les membres de la famille Finley-Cullen n'ont d'autre choix que de libérer leur ennemie jurée de prison.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: S15 E09 — L'enduranceRéalisant que Spartan n'est pas prêt à prendre sa retraite, Amy l'inscrit à une course d'endurance ; Jack est déterminé à dompter un cheval têtu même si les membres de sa famille craignent que cet entraînement ne soit dangereux.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: S15 E10 — Plus forts ensembleAmy reçoit une somme d'argent d'une source complètement inattendue; Jessica revient de New York et Tim ressent qu'elle lui cache quelque chose; à la suite d'un accident sur la piste de course, les plans de Lisa de reprendre la course sont compromis.

Hoping to enjoy her youth while it lasts, she's disappointed when her summer plans deposit her at a sleepy resort in the Catskills with her parents. Her luck turns around, however, when the resort's dance instructor, Johnny (Patrick Swayze), enlists Baby as his new partner, and the two fall in love. Baby's father forbids her from seeing Johnny, but she's determined to help him perform the last big dance of the summer.

Diabetic Shelby has a health scare, which is averted but doesn't bode well for her hopes of having children. Time passes, and the women and their friends encounter tragedy and good fortune, growing stronger and closer in the process.

One of them panics the following day when she suspects she really has poisoned the tyrant.

In contrast, foul-mouthed, hot-tempered detective Shannon Mullins (Melissa McCarthy) goes with her gut instincts and street smarts to remove criminals from the streets of Boston. Sparks fly when these polar opposites have to work together to capture a drug lord, but in the process, they become the last thing anyone expected -- buddies.

She wrecks her car, loses her job and finds her husband in a compromising position with their neighbor. It's time for Tammy to hit the road, but without money or transportation, her options are limited. Her only choice is a road trip with her grandmother, Pearl (Susan Sarandon), who has a car, cash and an itch to see Niagara Falls. It's not the escape Tammy had in mind, but it may be what she needs.

programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Lie With Me
programme.desc: A young man (Eric Balfour) and woman (Lauren Lee Smith) enjoy sexual compatibility but have trouble communicating and helping each other with problems.

programme.title: Borealis
programme.desc: Acclaimed director Kevin McMahon travels deep into the heart of the boreal forest. Borealis offers an immersive portrait of the lifecycles of the forest from the perspective of the plants and animals that live there.

programme.title: Beyond Paper
programme.desc: In the age of the virtual revolution, a filmmaker travels the world, navigating between the paper and digital realms to understand the future of human memory.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: A New Jersey teen moves to California, meets bullies and learns karate from a handyman, Mr. Miyagi.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: S01 E11 — InstinctDr. Magnus and the Sanctuary team attempt to capture a rare and deadly creature while under the watchful eye of a local news crew.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in Paris' Louvre Museum and cryptic clues in some of Leonardo da Vinci's most famous paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery. For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that -- should it come to light -- could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: When Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon discovers the resurgence of an ancient brotherhood known as the Illuminati, he flies to Rome to warn the Vatican, the Illuminati's most hated enemy. Joining forces with beautiful Italian scientist Vittoria Vetra, Langdon follows a centuries-old trail of ancient symbols in the hope of preventing the Illuminati's deadly plot against the Roman Catholic Church from coming to fruition.

programme.title: Captain Phillips
programme.desc: In April 2009, the U.S. container ship Maersk Alabama sails toward its destination on a day that seems like any other. Suddenly, Somali pirates race toward the vessel, climb aboard and take everyone hostage. The captain of the ship, Richard Phillips, looks to protect his crew from the hostile invaders, and their leader, Muse. The pirates are after millions of dollars, and Phillips must use his wits to make sure everyone survives and returns home safely.

programme.title: Stories We Tell
programme.desc: Through a series of revealing interviews, filmmaker Sarah Polley investigates the truth about her family history.

programme.title: Cairo Time
programme.desc: With some time off from her job as a magazine editor, New Yorker Juliette (Patricia Clarkson) decides to share a holiday with her husband, who works for the United Nations. Upon arriving in Cairo, however, she finds he's stuck in Gaza, and he sends his former bodyguard, Tareq (Alexander Siddig) -- now relocated back in Cairo to work at his family business -- to act as her guide around the city. Soon Juliette finds herself captivated by both the city and her companion.

programme.title: Step Dogs
programme.desc: Meatball, a wise cracking country dog, and Cassie, Hollywood's most pampered pet, meet when their owners get married. The two fight constantly until burglars break into their house, and they must team up to protect their home.

programme.title: Madame Tutli-Putli
programme.desc: A stunning, stop-motion animated film that takes the viewer on an exhilarating existential journey.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Jamie Graham (Christian Bale), a privileged English boy, is living in Shanghai when the Japanese invade and force all foreigners into prison camps. Jamie is captured with an American sailor named Basie (John Malkovich), who looks out for him while they are in the camp together. Even though he is separated from his parents and in a hostile environment, Jamie maintains his dignity and youthful spirits, providing a beacon of hope for the others held captive with him.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Magnus, Will and their colleague Allison Grant are stranded when their plane goes down in a desolate mountain range; while anxiously waiting for a rescue team, the passengers fall victim to a series of deadly attacks and vivid nightmares.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: When a mating pair of abnormals is brought in for scientific study, the team begins to exhibit attractions for each other.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Ready, set, snow! Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race, only to break down right before the finish line. Convinced that Zac cheated, Frankie demands a rematch and raises the stakes by betting his team's clubhouse. Frankie and the gang build a spectacular new race track and the stage is set for the biggest race of the season.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss (Anna Chlumsky) has good reason to be morbid: her mother died giving birth to her, and her father (Dan Aykroyd) operates a funeral service out of their home. The other kids think she's a freak, and it certainly doesn't help that her best friend, Thomas J. Sennett (Macaulay Culkin), is a boy. To make matters worse, Vada is desperately in love with her English teacher, Mr. Bixler (Griffin Dunne). What's an 11-year-old girl to do?

programme.title: The Imitation Game
programme.desc: In 1939, newly created British intelligence agency MI6 recruits Cambridge mathematics alumnus Alan Turing (Benedict Cumberbatch) to crack Nazi codes, including Enigma -- which cryptanalysts had thought unbreakable. Turing's team, including Joan Clarke (Keira Knightley), analyze Enigma messages while he builds a machine to decipher them. Turing and team finally succeed and become heroes, but in 1952, the quiet genius encounters disgrace when authorities reveal he is gay and send him to prison.

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: Doug MacRay leads a band of ruthless bank robbers and has no real attachments except for James, who -- despite his dangerous temper -- is like a brother. Everything changes for Doug when James briefly takes a hostage, bank employee Claire Keesey. Learning that she lives in the gang's neighborhood, Doug seeks her out to discover what she knows, and he falls in love. As the romance deepens, he wants out of his criminal life, but that could threaten Claire.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: The wife and son of a Mexican drug lord embark on a vengeful quest to kill all those involved in his trial and imprisonment -- including Miami Detective Mike Lowrey. When Mike gets wounded, he teams up with partner Marcus Burnett and AMMO -- a special tactical squad -- to bring the culprits to justice. But the old-school cops must soon learn to get along with their new elite counterparts if they are to take down the vicious cartel that threatens their lives.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: An entrepreneur and his family begin to unravel after moving into an old country manor in England in the 1980s.

programme.title: Laurence Anyways
programme.desc: In the '90s, Laurence tells his girlfriend, Fred, that he wants to become a woman; they confront the prejudices of their friends, ignore the council of their families and brave the phobias of the society they offend.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: A lovable dog must rely on some new friends to help it break out of canine prison and get back home to his owners.

programme.title: Nechako: It Will Be a Big River Again
programme.desc: Indigenous communities fight to restore Canada's Nechako River 70 years after damming. Through interviews, archives, and landscapes, their struggle to reclaim waters and preserve culture unfolds in this meditative documentary.

programme.title: Maybe Elephants
programme.desc: Three rebellious teenage daughters, a restless mother, a father struggling with potatoes and maybe some elephants, find themselves in Nairobi. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Star Wars Kid: The Rise of the Digital Shadows
programme.desc: Ghyslain Raza recalls how he recorded the clip that would change his life and become the first-ever viral-video meme in the early 2000s.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus travels to Rome to lead a covert meeting on abnormals; the Cabal seeks revenge for the release of the three witches from Scotland.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: A young artist with the ability to draw detailed pictures from memory may be the key to solving a case surrounding the suspicious death of his abusive father.

programme.title: Goose!
programme.desc: A boy (Max Morrow) conspires to save a talking gander from a man (Chevy Chase) who plans to cook the bird in an upcoming culinary contest.

programme.title: Dumb & Dumber
programme.desc: Imbecilic best friends Lloyd Christmas (Jim Carrey) and Harry Dunne (Jeff Daniels) stumble across a suitcase full of money left behind in Harry's car by Mary Swanson (Lauren Holly), who was on her way to the airport. The pair decide to go to Aspen, Colo., to return the money, unaware that it is connected to a kidnapping. As Harry and Lloyd -- who has fallen in love with Mary -- are pursued across the country by hired killers and police, they find both their friendship and their brains tested.

programme.title: Think Like a Man
programme.desc: For one reason or another, friends Dominic, Jeremy, Michael and Zeke just can't seem to seal the deal with the women in their lives. When their lovely ladies buy a book by comic Steve Harvey and start to apply its advice to their relationships, this band of brothers gets all shook up. Learning that they have been betrayed by one of their own, Dominic and his friends conspire to use the book's teachings to turn the tables.

programme.title: City of Angels
programme.desc: This is the story of Seth (Nicolas Cage), an angel who wanders the Los Angeles area invisible to humans. As the demise of an individual approaches, he spends time near them and becomes visible while acting as their traveling companion during their trip to the great hereafter. His discovery of distraught heart surgeon Maggie (Meg Ryan) inspires him to forego his immortality and exist on earth with her as a feeling and mortal entity.

programme.title: Predator
programme.desc: Dutch, a soldier of fortune, is hired by the U.S. government to secretly rescue a group of politicians trapped in Guatemala. But when Dutch and his team, which includes weapons expert Blain and CIA agent George, land in Central America, something is wrong. After finding a string of dead bodies, the crew discovers they are being hunted by a brutal creature with superhuman strength and the ability to disappear into its surroundings.

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: Brought together on a mysterious planet, a mercenary (Adrien Brody) and a group of cold-blooded killers now become the prey. A new breed of aliens pursues the ragtag humans through dense jungle. The group must work together to survive, or become the latest trophies of the fearsome intergalactic hunters.

programme.title: The Colony
programme.desc: Forced to live underground, survivors of an ice age embark on a mission to reach another outpost.

programme.title: Dangerous
programme.desc: An ex-con and reformed sociopath battles a band of heavily armed mercenaries as he tries to uncover the truth behind his brother's mysterious death.

programme.title: Passchendaele
programme.desc: Sgt. Dunne returns to war to look after a nurse's brother.

programme.title: Upside Down
programme.desc: Though it is forbidden, a man devises a way to reunite with a long-lost love from the twin world that sits just above his own.

programme.title: Snowtime!
programme.desc: Children (Angela Gallupo, Lucinda Davis, Sonja Ball) in a small village learn valuable life lessons when they form two teams for a massive snowball fight.

programme.title: Ladies and Gentlemen ... Mr. Leonard Cohen
programme.desc: Donald Brittain uses interviews and appearances to profile the poet in 1965.

programme.title: The Unbreakable Boy
programme.desc: When Scott and Teresa learn that their son, Austin, is autistic and has brittle bone disease, they initially worry about his future. However, with Scott's growing faith and Austin's incredible spirit, they become unbreakable as they find joy, gratitude and courage in the most trying times.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus and Will investigate a distressing call for help deep below the Bermuda Triangle resulting in a deadly battle to save Magnus's life.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of an old college friend, Will finds himself caught in an underground fight club.

programme.title: Air Bud
programme.desc: Diffident in the wake of his father's death, high schooler Josh (Kevin Zegers) struggles to adapt to his new home in Washington state. That all changes, however, when he signs up to be the school basketball team's manager and discovers that his pet dog Bud, a stray golden retriever he took in, can play the sport amazingly well. After Bud joins the team, Josh's life brightens considerably, until the dog's former owner Norm Snively (Michael Jeter) returns in hopes of reclaiming the pooch.

programme.title: Superman III
programme.desc: Computer programmer Gus Gorman (Richard Pryor) is hired by financial tycoon Ross Webster (Robert Vaughn) to seize control of a weather satellite and annihilate Colombia's coffee crop. When Superman (Christopher Reeve) manages to thwart the plan, Webster commands Gorman to use the satellite to locate kryptonite, the Man of Steel's mortal weakness. But a missing unknown element in the kryptonite -- replaced by Gorman with tar -- causes an unintended side effect when presented to Superman.

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: A former government operative comes out of retirement and uses all his extensive training to rescue his estranged daughter from a slave trade operation.

programme.title: Black Sails
programme.desc: Flint gives advice to Dufresne; Silver works to become indispensable; Eleanor is called upon to remove a captain from power; Rackham gets ambitious.

programme.title: Black Sails
programme.desc: Flint returns to Nassau and encounters a dilemma; Eleanor turns to an unlikely source for help; Rackham works to restore his reputation; Vane gets an unexpected prize.

programme.title: From the World of John Wick: Ballerina
programme.desc: Trained in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma, Eve Macarro takes on an army of killers as she seeks revenge against those responsible for the death of her father.

programme.title: Enemy
programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Lie With Me
programme.desc: Promiscuous Torontonians Leila and David meet at a nightclub and have immediate chemistry. Drawn in by her rampant sexuality, David leaves his girlfriend to pursue a casual but intense carnal relationship with Leila. As Leila's parents head toward divorce and David becomes an increasingly crowding presence in her life, she struggles with her crippling fear of emotional intimacy and mulls over the ramifications of entering a committed relationship.

programme.title: Borealis
programme.desc: Acclaimed director Kevin McMahon travels deep into the heart of the boreal forest to explore the chorus of life in Canada's iconic wilderness. Analyzing how trees move, communicate and survive the destructive forces of fire, insects and human encroachment, Borealis offers an immersive portrait of the lifecycles of the forest from the perspective of the plants and animals that live there.

programme.title: Beyond Paper
programme.desc: In the age of the virtual revolution, a filmmaker travels the world, navigating between the paper and digital realms to understand the future of human memory.

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Daniel (Ralph Macchio) moves to Southern California with his mother, Lucille (Randee Heller), but quickly finds himself the target of a group of bullies who study karate at the Cobra Kai dojo. Fortunately, Daniel befriends Mr. Miyagi (Noriyuki "Pat" Morita), an unassuming repairman who just happens to be a martial arts master himself. Miyagi takes Daniel under his wing, training him in a more compassionate form of karate and preparing him to compete against the brutal Cobra Kai.

programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach.

programme.title: Clara Haskil : le mystère de l'interprète
programme.desc: Haskil suffers from chronic health issues and lives through two world wars, which holds back her career; only after WWII does Haskil's fame begin to take off, and she finally enjoys international recognition.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Czech Philharmonic in this concert program featuring works by Antonín Dvořák and Gustav Mahler, recorded at the Rudolfinum, Dvořák Hall, Prague on March 1, 2019.

programme.title: Piano works by Chopin, Debussy, Granados A.O
programme.desc: As part of the "Solistas del Siglo XXI" series, pianist Nicolas Bourdoncle performs Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 1; Chopin's Piano Sonata in B-flat minor, Op. 35; Toccata from Claude Debussy's suite Pour le piano.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg's last major performance with his band, the Instant Composers Pool Orchestra.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Works for Cello and Piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music.

programme.title: Brahms Tragic Overture & Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No.8
programme.desc: Gustavo Dudamel and the Simón Bolívar Symphony Orchestra perform Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8, known as "The Symphony of a Thousand."

programme.title: Budapest Festival Orchestra & Iván Fischer : Beethoven
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra with soloist Richard Goode, performs Beethoven's Symphony No 1 in C major, Op 21, and Concerto for piano No 4 in G major, Op 58.

programme.title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Mozart -- Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: Various participants and teachers participate in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Berlioz: The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra perform Berlioz's "La Damnation de Faust."

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Ginandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il Basso Napolitano
programme.desc: Alessandro Scarlatti's "Quante i boschi han piane"; Nicola Fago's "Contro colpi di fortuna"; Nicola Porpora's "Idre, arpie, draghi e leoni"; Angelo Ragazzi's "Sonata a quatt."

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantaisie, op. 61
programme.desc: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantaisie, op. 61

programme.title: Classica Spotlight

programme.title: Mozart -- Requiem in D Minor, K. 626

programme.title: Bach: Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Bach: Brandenburg Concerto No. 5

programme.title: Handel: Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The story behind Georg Frideric Handel's "Messiah, HWV 56," which depicts the life and suffering of Christ.

programme.title: Chopin -- Introduction & Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin and Sergei Rachmaninoff.

programme.title: Patmos -- A Musical Documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival; we capture the 2024 edition, featuring performances by soloists and ensembles.

programme.title: Chopin - Fantaisie in F minor, Op. 49

programme.title: Bach

programme.title: Beethoven, Symphony No. 3 in E flat major, Op. 55 Eroica

programme.title: Chamber Music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and Others
